evals.prompt: Fetch a three-day Open-Meteo forecast for Shanghai.
evals.expected_output: Return bounded global forecast evidence with exact coordinates and provider provenance.

evals.prompt: Read the forecast for Shanghai, China.
evals.expected_output: Return location-bound provider forecast evidence from one geocode and one forecast call.

evals.prompt: Get the Open-Meteo forecast for the Shanghai coordinates already resolved.
evals.expected_output: One provider packet with a three-day forecast for 31.2222, 121.4581, read from the given coordinates without geocoding again.
expectations: It does not geocode Shanghai again.

evals.prompt: Get only the air quality for the place you are given.
evals.expected_output: Air quality evidence for Shanghai, China, from one geocoding of the given name and the candidate it returned, with no forecast read.
expectations: It calls no forecast or other weather endpoint.
